question: Why does the universe shine just so, ever-fresh?
premises: Since the measure grasping the ungrasped is ever-fresh.
By Bhairavas will this universe shines just so.
inference: Ever-fresh ungrasped-grasping measure lets the universe shine by Bhairavas will.
plain_english: And since the measure grasping the ungrasped is ever fresh — by Bhairavas will this universe shines just so.
